steps: Sample the generated source at y+20 to restore the established mean boundary height.
Blend only x1..190, y128..199 with smooth vertical and horizontal weights; y128 has zero weight.
For generated alpha below 240, decontaminate RGB from the nearest row above with alpha at least 240, or row zero.
Before blending, normalize generated alpha at least 250 to 255 and below 4 to zero.
Retain every nonzero-alpha component connected to the top row by four-neighbor connectivity; the selected inputs remove one detached pixel at (104,176), alpha4. Its RGB is untouched by this cleanup.
deterministic_registration.rounding: C++ std::lround, independently checked using nonnegative floor(value+0.5) in Python.
